results.statement: For any selected nonempty family of actual physical 3x3 minors of an original-coordinate cross matrix, if its determinant-weighted normalized row marginals are all at most 1/2, then the full quadratic-plus-affine output has continuous density bounded by 3e times the selected determinant mass to the power -1/6.

For A[H,I]=P C^T with P^T P=I2, arbitrary D=A[I,I], max diag(PP^T)<=1/2, and G_*=sum singleton augmented third volumes squared >0, the density is continuous and ||p_Q||inf <= 3e(512/27)^(1/6) G_*^(-1/6) <13.317 G_*^(-1/6), with the same coefficient for interval length.

actual_dependency.application: On a target-valid 8x8 regression with a literal physical 3x3 cross block determinant 1/2, applied ||p_Q||inf<=3|det K|^(-1/3) to get 3*2^(1/3)=3.779763149684619.
